short_description:
GTA 6's Platinum trophy, "Vice Got a Price!", needs 100% completion and every other trophy; trophy guides estimate up to about 200 hours. In launch week, the fan trophy tracker PSNProfiles listed a PS5 player, Danpool85, as the first to earn it (reported by GamingBible, TheGamer and Tech4Gamers). PSNProfiles isn't run by PlayStation, and Rockstar and Sony haven't confirmed a world first. How long will your Platinum take?

Sources: GamingBible, TheGamer, Tech4Gamers, GGRecon, KeenGamer.
